How I work · one version of truth

Define the metric before the tool

Before I joined, CHs, finance and management each counted revenue differently. I wrote the rules down and locked them, so every sheet and dashboard reads the same number.

Cohort monthA lead belongs to its scan month, not its payment month, so revenue can't slide into a later month.
Valid signupSignup on the scan date (first version: within 0–3 days); separates real conversions from old users re-scanning.
BD revenueIST sales count at 50%, everything else at 100%: a fair split with the influencer team.
MappingThe current month's BDM/CH map applies to all history; leavers show as "Left", never a dummy owner.
PipelineRaw → clean → validate → business logic → KPI layer → dashboard. Dashboards never read raw data.
~3,088lead dates found with day and month swapped
275 rowswith no CH: 9 BDMs missing from the map
91%of payments: buyer's college ≠ seller's college
